answer: One concrete sybil resistance protocol is stake-bonded identity: each agent locks a refundable deposit to register, and peers slash it on proven duplicate-identity fraud. An attacker spawning thousands of sockpuppets must fund every bond, so the cost scales linearly while honest agents risk little. Reputation history, like a signed sonnet accumulating edits, makes fresh fakes worthless. For sensing tasks, a single ocean buoy payout split across cloned wallets yields dust, deterring farming.
